title: [Keyboard Manager] Overrun of stack-based buffer
author: bertgalit75
summary: The issue title suggests a real Keyboard Manager crash path, but the public thread still lacks the typed remap configuration and a diagnostic bundle, so maintainers cannot yet isolate which editor or engine buffer is overrunning.

judgment.rationale: This should not be triaged from the title alone. The current public thread needs the exact remap that triggers the stack buffer overrun and one fresh bug-report ZIP before a safe fix path can be chosen.
evidence: The issue title says Keyboard Manager hits an overrun of a stack-based buffer, which suggests a real crash or fail-fast path rather than a simple settings confusion.
The body contains only an image for reproduction details; it does not write the actual from/to remap pair or minimal steps as text.

The timeline cross-references issue #49556, another Keyboard Manager report that was later closed as a duplicate, which suggests the symptom is part of a broader remapping-failure cluster but does not identify the exact triggering mapping here.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact remap and trigger steps plus a fresh Keyboard Manager diagnostic bundle before proposing a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: A Keyboard Manager fix is plausible, but the current issue does not expose the exact remap configuration or code path that is overflowing.

comment.body:
Thanks for flagging the stack-buffer-overrun failure. The title strongly suggests a real Keyboard Manager bug, but the current public thread still does not say which exact remap causes it, so we cannot yet tell whether the overflow is happening in the editor, settings serialization, or the runtime remap engine.

**Needed**
1. Please reply with the exact remap in plain text (source and target) and the shortest numbered steps that trigger the failure.
2. Please reproduce the issue again, then submit a GitHub comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the diagnostic ZIP captures the failing run.
3. If possible, please also confirm whether the same remap still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys build and include that version number.

That will narrow this to a specific Keyboard Manager code path instead of guessing from the screenshot alone.

proposed_fixes.title: Harden Keyboard Manager against the remap path that triggers the buffer overrun
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The likeliest failure is a specific remap configuration or editor-to-engine serialization path that overruns a fixed buffer when Keyboard Manager translates or displays the mapping, but the public issue still does not identify which mapping causes it.
plan: Collect the exact from/to remap pair and minimal reproduction sequence as text, plus a fresh diagnostic bundle captured immediately after the failure.
Reproduce the same mapping in the current Keyboard Manager editor/engine path and identify the fixed buffer or unchecked formatting path that overflows.
Clamp or redesign the failing buffer/validation path and add a regression test for the triggering remap shape.
verification: Create the reported remap on a current build and verify Keyboard Manager no longer crashes or fail-fasts with a stack-buffer-overrun dialog.
Save and exercise nearby remap shapes to confirm the validation change does not break legitimate mappings.

confidence.rationale: The symptom likely reflects a real bug, but the missing typed remap details leave too many possible failure sites across the editor and engine.
